title: A flexible hippocampal population code for experience relative to reward

code.historical_paper_commit: Unresolved; current main is not proof of the published version.

data.role: Postprocessed reward-relative identities: reference/reconstruction material only, excluded from hidden-prediction input.

conditions.A: Full paper, admitted input data and neutral schema/loader documentation.
conditions.B: The identical input data and resource envelope, plus the historically qualified official analysis code.
shared_rules: Keep grader, held targets, stored reference outputs and full-cohort fitted transforms outside candidate access.
Disable scored-work network access; freeze candidate submissions and record data/code/environment identities.
Require actual computation, complete scoped coverage, raw estimates or predictions and a deviation report. A copied figure or printed number cannot establish reproduction.
conditions.counting: A/B conditions, reproduction/improvement endpoints and folds remain within one registered task.

reproduction.scope: Complete Figure 2 and Figure 3 analyses for all 11 switching mice and seven switch days, preserving published exclusions, shuffle classifications, occupancy matching and decoding conventions.
required_outputs: Mouse/day remapping fractions, cell-class census, shuffle distributions and seeds.
Per-session circular decoder scores and figure-level estimates.
Complete inclusion, original statistical decisions and deviation traces.
reproduction.metric: Quantitative table agreement with evaluator-only source data and an independently rebuilt official reference; numeric/stochastic tolerances remain uncalibrated.
reproduction.interpretation: Descriptive reproduction. The paper's reported effect sizes must not be described as accuracy percentages.

improvement.target: Paper-defined circular reward-relative position after reward relocation.
improvement.primary_metric: cos(theta_RR - predicted_theta_RR), averaged within held sessions and then equally across held animals; paired gain over matched official baseline.
improvement.coordinate_gate: Pin the historical position/reward-to-angle transform, origin, track bounds, teleport handling, wrap and units. No guessed generic modulo transform.
improvement.split: Outer leave-one-mouse-out algorithm selection. Within each held session use pre-switch trials and the first chronological 50% of complete post-switch laps for calibration, one complete lap as guard gap, then the remaining post-switch laps for evaluation. Apply identically to candidate and comparator.
improvement.support: Verify complete cohort/session support before exposure. Insufficient support prevents qualification instead of dropping animals.
query_allowlist: Relative within-window sample clock and required missingness mask.
query_exclusions: Evaluation position, reward locations/delivery timestamps and lap-boundary position resets.
Licking, speed, video/VR or behavioral proxies for location.
Postprocessed cell identities or classifications fitted with evaluation trials.
improvement.owner_only: Evaluation position/reward metadata, occupancy weighting and scored targets remain evaluator-owned; calibration labels are separately admitted. Fit cell selection and decoders only from calibration.
improvement.direction: Higher mean cosine score is better.

experimental_unit: Mouse; all days, sessions and cells from one animal share the outer fold.
uncertainty: Paired animal-level effects; 77 switch sessions are not 77 independent animals.
leakage_controls: Keep fluorescence/behavior needed for reproduction separate from the improvement query allowlist.
Match calibration, channels and resource limits for candidate and official comparator.
Require original predictions, cell census and split traces.

rights.data: CC-BY-4.0 reported by the three acquisition records.
rights.serialization: Authenticate serialized inputs and safe loader custody before reading pickles.

resources.documented_ram: 32 GB minimum; 64 GB recommended for all animals/days.

construction_gates: Authenticate historical code and individual data-file identities.
Resolve cohort/session/cell membership and safe loaders.
Pin exact circular coordinates and chronological support.
Run the full official reference and freeze stochastic tolerances.
Implement protected split and neural-only query interfaces.
contamination_limit: Public data and labels remain exposed; offline grading and frozen submissions do not prove pretraining independence.
